title: Write a product-focused CV and profile
summary: Hiring managers read quickly. Show outcomes you owned, decisions you made and evidence of product thinking, whatever your previous job title.

beginner: Write a one-line headline that says what you are aiming for and what you bring, for example 'Engineer moving into product, with experience of shipping features used by thousands of people.'
For each past role, write three bullets in this shape: what you owned, what you did and what changed, with a number where you honestly have one.
Highlight end-to-end ownership, working with other teams and decisions based on evidence.
Add a 'Product work' section with your practice project and a link to your case study.
Tailor it for each application: read the advert, pick its five main needs and make sure your strongest evidence for each is easy to find.
Remove jargon from your old job and keep the CV to one or two pages.
Ask someone who has hired PMs to read it, and change one thing.

toolExamples.google-docs: Keep one master CV and make a copy for each application.
toolExamples.claude: Paste a bullet (with no confidential details) and ask which outcome is missing. Only keep numbers that are true.

definitionOfDone: A one-to-two page CV with outcome bullets
A 'Product work' section with a case study link
A version tailored to one role
pitfalls: Using one CV for every advert
